archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) combined with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast Layout)
vibe: Hedge-fund / quant desk meets cyberpunk trading terminal. Cinematic, asymmetric, high-contrast.

scale.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono text-[#e2f331]
scale.numbering: text-8xl sm:text-[10vw] font-display font-light leading-none opacity-20

header.anatomy: Sticky glassmorphism header `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0a0e14]/70 z-50 border-b border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.07)]`.
elements: Navigation links centered (Algoritmalar, Paket, Hakkımızda, İletişim)
Language Toggle `[ TR / EN ]` right, monospace font

hero.styles: Min-height 90vh, pt-32, flex flex-col justify-center relative overflow-hidden
elements: H1: 'Data is new oil. AI is new electricity.'
Left column: Sticky. Large editorial number (e.g., '01') + Section Title.
Right column: Hero copy, TradingView Script Image, Pricing Grid.
Pricing Grid: 4-tier cards (3 ay, 6 ay, 12 ay, Tek Seferlik).

pricing_card.anatomy: Flat minimalist technical grid style. `bg-[#0e141b] border border-[rgba(255,255,255,0.07)] p-6 flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden`.
pricing_card.highlight_12_month: Add `border-[#e2f331]` and a subtle inner glow.
elements: Discount Badge: Absolute top-right, mint green `#00ffa3` text, dark bg.
CTA Button: 'Seç'. When clicked, toggles visibility of Whop Checkout iframe inline below the button.

whop_iframe_container.anatomy: Div that expands below the 'Seç' button when active. Min-height 600px. Smooth transition using Framer Motion or Tailwind.

all_in_one_pack.anatomy: Massive standout section. Pure black background `bg-black border border-[#e2f331]/30 p-12`.
elements: Hype banner: 'Şimdi Üye olun Tanışma Bonusunu Kaçırmayın!'
Full pricing block with original prices line-through, lifetime access.

micro_interactions.hover: Buttons have `hover:bg-[#cde010] hover:text-black` transition. Cards lift slightly `-translate-y-1` and border illuminates `hover:border-[#e2f331]/50`.
micro_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. Fade in up for algorithm sections.

hero_background.description: Abstract data grid chart for the cinematic hero background.

algo_01.description: TradingView preview for ML Quant & Liquidity Engine

algo_02.description: TradingView preview for Right Side Strategy Osc.

algo_03.description: TradingView preview for Liquidity Based SR

algo_05.description: TradingView preview for tRend Cycles for Mag7

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML and Tailwind for layouts, avoiding overly rigid Shadcn sections for the main flow.
Add Unbounded, Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, Azeret Mono, and Cormorant Garamond fonts to the project (e.g. via Google Fonts in index.html).
Configure tailwind.config.js with the custom colors defined in 'colors' section.
Build the hero with a dark overlay over the provided background image.
Implement the algorithm sections (01 to 05) using the exact Turkish titles provided in the problem statement.

For the Whop integration: Build the pricing cards so that clicking 'Seç' toggles a state (e.g., expandedPlanId) which renders the Whop iframe container directly inside/below that specific card, expanding its height without breaking the grid.
